images.author: Luca Galuzzi
images.why: 2000 × 1333; iconic Tibet-side north face with a prominent summit. Strong mountain-centred option, although cropping reduces usable resolution.

images.author: Ggia
images.why: 8533 × 2924; featured photograph of the classic north face from Tibet. Ample resolution for a summit-centred 9:10 crop from the wide panorama.

images.author: Matheus Hobold Sovernigo
images.why: 5848 × 4387; classic Nepal-side view from Kala Patthar, with clear sky and the Khumbu Glacier. Generous resolution for cropping around Everest.

images.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
images.why: 3409 × 2688; Nepal-side view highlighting Everest’s west ridge. Relatively compact framing suits a near-square poster.

images.author: Pavel Novak
images.why: 2304 × 3456; portrait photograph from the classic Kala Patthar viewpoint. Crop vertically to 9:10 while retaining Everest’s summit.

images.author: Muhammadbinmasood
images.why: 5186 × 3457; sunset photograph from Concordia, combining K2’s recognisable pyramid with dramatic evening illumination.

images.author: Maqsood aktar
images.why: 5809 × 3878; classic Concordia view with warm evening light and dramatic cloud. High resolution allows a strong summit-focused crop.

images.author: Molly Tolzmann
images.why: 5760 × 3840; photograph from the Pakistan-side Concordia trek, offering a high-resolution alternative for a mountain-centred poster crop.

images.author: Flyingman420
images.why: 6000 × 4000; classic Darjeeling sunrise view with blue sky. The main summit sits near the centre, useful for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Sudipto2cool
images.why: 6016 × 4000; long-exposure photograph from Pelling with moonlit peaks and village lights. Distinctive night option with substantial cropping room.

images.author: Sivaln
images.why: 3648 × 2048; sunrise view from Darjeeling. Position the 9:10 crop left of centre to retain the main summit.

images.author: Tanu.shrivastava
images.why: 4608 × 3456; morning photograph from Darjeeling with the main summit near the centre. A flexible 4:3 original for near-square cropping.

images.author: Gradythebadger
images.why: 4896 × 3264; dedicated summit photograph, the strongest candidate here for emphasising the mountain in a tight poster crop.

images.author: Gradythebadger
images.why: 4896 × 3264; established view from Gophu La Pass showing the mountain in its surrounding landscape, with room for a summit-centred crop.

images.author: dhaag23
images.why: 4000 × 3000; distant Bhutan-side view from Dochula Pass. Useful alternative perspective, though less summit-dominant than the first two.
